# 10 - DNS embebido de Docker (127.0.0.11)

$ cat /etc/resolv.conf (joomla)
# Generated by Docker Engine.
# This file can be edited; Docker Engine will not make further changes once it
# has been modified.

nameserver 127.0.0.11
search .
options edns0 trust-ad ndots:0

# Based on host file: '/etc/resolv.conf' (internal resolver)
# ExtServers: [host(127.0.0.53)]
# Overrides: []
# Option ndots from: internal

$ iptables -t nat -S  (namespace de joomla: redireccion de 127.0.0.11:53)
-P PREROUTING ACCEPT
-P INPUT ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-P POSTROUTING ACCEPT
-N DOCKER_OUTPUT
-N DOCKER_POSTROUTING
-A OUTPUT -d 127.0.0.11/32 -j DOCKER_OUTPUT
-A POSTROUTING -d 127.0.0.11/32 -j DOCKER_POSTROUTING
-A DOCKER_OUTPUT -d 127.0.0.11/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 53 -j DNAT --to-destination 127.0.0.11:44355
-A DOCKER_OUTPUT -d 127.0.0.11/32 -p udp -m udp --dport 53 -j DNAT --to-destination 127.0.0.11:44043
-A DOCKER_POSTROUTING -s 127.0.0.11/32 -p tcp -m tcp --sport 44355 -j SNAT --to-source :53
-A DOCKER_POSTROUTING -s 127.0.0.11/32 -p udp -m udp --sport 44043 -j SNAT --to-source :53

$ dig desde un cliente en frontend_net
nginx     -> 172.20.0.5
joomla    -> 172.20.0.4
jupyter   -> 172.20.0.2
grafana   -> 172.20.0.3
database  -> (sin respuesta: no esta en esta red)

;; ANSWER SECTION:
joomla.			600	IN	A	172.20.0.4
--
;; SERVER: 127.0.0.11#53(127.0.0.11) (UDP)
;; WHEN: Sat Oct 03 07:39:01 UTC 2026

$ dig desde un cliente en backend_net
nginx     -> (sin respuesta: no esta en esta red)
joomla    -> 172.21.0.5
database  -> 172.21.0.2
jupyter   -> 172.21.0.3
grafana   -> 172.21.0.4
